# Astronomical 0.2.60
A signed, notarized Stable release distributed through the GitHub release download and the Sparkle update feed.
## What changed
- The prompt cache persists and reuses the previous turn's partial tail block, improving throughput for repeated and follow-up prompts. - Qwen3.8-35B-A3B-Distill-oQ6e-mtp is onboarded, with corrected journey decode measurement. - The native MLX build streams live progress into CI, and cache eviction no longer forces CMake rebuilds. - Native and Rust compilation are fully separated: a prewarm step builds the native runtime before cargo starts, so the two never compete for cores and warm-cache compiles drop from minutes to seconds. - The commit gate runs checks in parallel with per-step timing instrumentation. - Image requests with out-of-envelope dimensions are rejected before queue admission, failing fast with a clear error instead of failing later in the pipeline.
## Compatibility
- Existing model directories, prompt caches, and user state are preserved. - Image requests that previously progressed with unsupported dimensions now fail fast at admission; resubmitting with supported dimensions works unchanged.
## Distribution
- The app bundle and nested Sparkle code are signed with the Developer ID Application identity and Hardened Runtime with secure timestamps. - The DMG is notarized by Apple and stapled; the ticket is validated before publication. - The Sparkle appcast is signed with the release feed key, and the feed envelope signature is validated after activation.
